headline: FY27 to be a pivotal year; EBITDA/kg guidance raised further

highlights: Key points  GALSURF reported second consecutive quarter of strong broad-based profitable growth.
Continued strong growth in India (15% volume growth YoY) along with recovery in AMET (volume up 16%/15% YoY/QoQ) after many quarters were the key highlights of 2QFY27.

Despite significantly elevated freight & power costs, GALSURF reported Rs26.1 EBITDA/kg during the quarter.  The management remains confident of sustaining the growth momentum, backed by recovery in underlying demand and continued traction in the value-added Specialty portfolio.

New launches in the Leave-on category, deeper customer relationships and opportunities in developed markets are expected to support profitable growth.  We maintain structurally positive stance on GALSURF led by market leadership in India and AMET regions and strengthening presence in developed markets backed by portfolio innovation and distribution expansion.
